Hi Chloe, this is Sarah Thompson from ClearPath Financial Solutions. Thanks so much for taking my call—I appreciate you being proactive about this. I'm here to help you get things sorted in a way that works for your situation.

I hear you’ve had a tough month, and I want to make sure we find a solution that fits your budget. My goal today is just to work with you on a realistic plan so we can get your account back on track.

To start, can you tell me a little about what’s been going on financially? That way, I can better understand what kind of payment arrangement might make sense right now.
